subject.title: fix(qqbot): queued and in-flight messages are lost when the gateway resumes after reconnect or restart

question: Should QQ Bot adopt this at-least-once reconnect contract, accepting possible duplicate delivery when a slow message holds the global cursor or a crash precedes the throttled session save?
rationale: The patch replaces silent message loss with replay and possible duplication; tests can verify mechanics, but the permanent channel delivery guarantee requires owner acceptance.

options.title: Accept at-least-once delivery
options.body: Land the watermark after exact-head checks, treating possible duplicate replay as preferable to silently losing queued or in-flight messages.

options.title: Require durable deduplication first
options.body: Pause the PR and design persistent message identity or acknowledgment handling that prevents both loss and duplicate processing.

recommendation.title: Accept at-least-once delivery
recommendation.body: Land the watermark after exact-head checks, treating possible duplicate replay as preferable to silently losing queued or in-flight messages.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history is most closely tied to the QQ Bot gateway, queue, and persisted-session architecture whose delivery contract changes here.
